        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    return G
G=load()

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=gi[0][0]
    res=[[v for v in row] for row in gi]
    ones=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(gi) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    sixes=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(gi) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==6]
    seg=None; kind=None
    for a in ones:
        for b in ones:
            da=a[0]-b[0]; db=a[1]-b[1]
            if abs(da)==abs(db):
                kind='main' if ((da>0 and db>0) or (da<0 and db<0)) else 'anti'
                seg=(a,b); break
        if seg: break
    const_=seg[0][0]-seg[0][1] if kind=='main' else seg[0][0]+seg[0][1]
    lo,hi=min(p[0] for p in seg),max(p[0] for p in seg)
    for r in range(lo,hi+1):
        c = r-const_ if kind=='main' else const_-r
        if 0<=c<W: res[r][c]=1
    for p in sixes:
        i,j=p
        on = (kind=='main' and i-j==const_) or (kind=='anti' and i+j==const_)
        if on:
            orth_const = i+j if kind=='main' else i-j
            dirs = [(-1,1),(1,-1)] if kind=='main' else [(-1,-1),(1,1)]
            for si,sj in dirs:
                cur=(i,j)
                while True:
                    nxt=(cur[0]+si,cur[1]+sj)
                    if not(0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W): break
                    if res[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bg: res[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]=6
                    cur=nxt
    return res

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=gi[0][0]
    res=[[v for v in row] for row in gi]
    ones=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(gi) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    sixes=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(gi) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==6]
    seg=None; kind=None
    for a in ones:
        for b in ones:
            da=a[0]-b[0]; db=a[1]-b[1]
            if abs(da)==abs(db):
                kind='main' if da*db>=0 else 'anti'; seg=(a,b); break
        if seg: break
    const_=seg[0][0]-seg[0][1] if kind=='main' else seg[0][0]+seg[0][1]
    lo,hi=min(p[0] for p in seg),max(p[0] for p in seg)
    for r in range(lo,hi+1):
        c = r-const_ if kind=='main' else const_-r
        if 0<=c<W: res[r][c]=1
    for p in sixes:
        i,j=p
        on = (kind=='main' and i-j==const_) or (kind=='anti' and i+j==const_)
        if on and lo<i<hi:
            orth_const = i+j if kind=='main' else i-j
            dirs = [(-1,-1),(1,1)] if kind=='main' else [(-1,1),(1,-1)]
            for si,sj in dirs:
                cur=(i,j)
                while True:
                    nxt=(cur[0]+si,cur[1]+sj)
                    if not(0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W): break
                    if res[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bg: res[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]=6
                    cur=nxt
    return res
print('d2',solve(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'],'d3',solve(G['Demo pair 3 input'])==G['Demo pair 3 output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
